status: ACCEPTED 0.1.0 (2026-10-23, Antigravity onboarding): baseline inventory of the four sanitized live 1.4.6 recordings; drift reports propose changes, review accepts them by editing this file and bumping specification_version

applies_to.capture_route: stdout read by CliCapture (launch --cli antigravity), independent byte copy
applies_to.route_limit: stdout only; stderr (soft-deny notices, background-task notices) is a separate artifact; the conversation SQLite store and the brain directory are native session files, archived and never read

provenance.reviewed: 2026-10-23 Antigravity onboarding; managing review at the onboarding checkpoint

limits: one CLI version (1.4.6) and one launch mode (headless print, stream-json) on this profile: the inventory is an observed shape, not a vendor promise
a field observed in one record is not universal; a field absent from a specimen is not removed; nullability is what was seen
variants are discriminated by event and, for step_update, by step_type and state; a new step type or state is a new variant, not an error
data-keyed subtrees (tool parameters, a --json-schema schema and structured output) are tool or user data: only value kinds are recorded
a change of meaning under an unchanged shape is not visible to this inventory; the semantic oracle judges values
the stream carries no timestamps; a step is identified only by its index within the conversation; the documentation lists step_type values as observed examples, not a closed vocabulary

four recordings in two permission modes (always-proceed and request-review): documented members not observed here (init.model, init.agent, init.json_schema, result.structured_output, result.json_schema, the checkpoint step) are declared by the vendor inventory only
